title: The reorg lands
summary: Jordan learned that instead of being laid off in the reorg, they're being moved to "legacy marketing pages" under a new manager, Priya — a low-status maintenance role that Jordan, Marcus's cheerful framing aside, recognizes as the place people get parked before eventual severance. Jordan felt flat and gray rather than relieved, and braced for the usual spiral (dark room, silence, days lost), but this time cut it short after only twenty minutes on the couch, choosing instead to go to Groundwork and work on Coda's snippet library — a shift Jordan notes cautiously as real progress since the "dark" episodes have always taken much longer to pass. Jordan texted Lena about the news and got a supportive, knowing reply, with Lena starting her own new role Friday.
